summary: Apply a weighted DGGS neighborhood kernel
description:
Applies a weighted focal operation on DGGS neighborhoods.

For each DGGS zone, the neighborhood is defined by topological ring distance in the same DGGS reference system (DGGRS). The weight at index `d` in `weights` is applied to all zones at ring distance `d` from the center zone.

This process is DGGS-native and provides a DGGS counterpart to ``apply_kernel()`` without relying on raster x/y kernels.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: A data cube with a DGGS dimension.

parameters.name: weights
parameters.description: Kernel weights by topological ring distance. The first value is the center-zone weight (`d = 0`), the second value applies to all zones in ring `d = 1`, and so on.

parameters.name: factor
parameters.description: A factor multiplied to each computed value after the weighted neighborhood sum.

parameters.name: replace_invalid
parameters.description: Value used to replace non-numerical, NaN, no-data, or infinite numerical values before applying the weighted sum.

returns.description: A DGGS data cube with the newly computed values and the same dimensions. The dimension properties (name, type, labels, reference system and resolution) remain unchanged.

DimensionNotAvailable.message: A DGGS dimension with the specified name does not exist.
